_src: ESPN coaches API (current coach names), Wikipedia coaching records and school releases, checked Oct 18, 2026. Records are through 2025-26.

Butler.name: Ronald Nored
Butler.bio: Butler PG (2008-12), Atlanta Hawks assistant 2023-26, Long Island Nets (G League) head coach 2016-18. Replaced Thad Matta (retired; 4 losing Big East seasons)

Nebraska.name: Fred Hoiberg
Nebraska.bio: '26: 28-7, Sweet 16 (program-record 28 wins). Iowa St. 2010-15 (115-56), Chicago Bulls 2015-18

Sam Houston.name: Chris Mudge
Sam Houston.bio: Promoted 2023 after 13 years as Jason Hooten's assistant. '26: 22-12, 13-7 CUSA, NIT

Idaho St..name: Ryan Looney
Idaho St..bio: '26: 13-20, 5-13 Big Sky. Point Loma, Seattle Pacific, Eastern Oregon before

Wichita St..name: Paul Mills
Wichita St..bio: Oral Roberts 2017-23 (2023 Summit perfect regular season). '26: 24-12, 13-5 American

TAMU-CC.name: Jim Shaw
TAMU-CC.bio: Promoted 2023 after Steve Lutz left. '26: 18-15, 13-9 Southland

Utah Valley.name: Todd Phillips
Utah Valley.bio: Boise native. Salt Lake CC 2011-19 (205-58, 2016 NJCAA title). '26: 25-9, WAC champs, NIT. Now in the Big West

Santa Clara.name: Herb Sendek
Santa Clara.bio: '26: 26-9, 15-3 WCC, NCAA first round. NC State 1996-2006, Arizona St. 2006-15

Lamar.name: Jordan Fee
Lamar.bio: Florida Atlantic associate HC 2025-26; Gannon (D-II) 2023-24, 32-3, Elite Eight. Added seven transfers in May

Utah St..name: Ben Jacobson
Utah St..bio: 20 seasons at UNI (2006-26); '26 UNI: 23-13, NCAA first round. Hired by USU Mar 30, 2026

Oregon St..name: Justin Joyner
Oregon St..bio: Michigan assistant 2024-26 (58-13). Replaced Wayne Tinkle (let go Feb 2026 after 12 seasons)

Texas St..name: Terrence Johnson
Texas St..bio: '26: 19-13, 11-7 Sun Belt (T-2nd). Now in the Pac-12

Colorado St..name: Ali Farokhmanesh
Colorado St..bio: Promoted Mar 2025 when Niko Medved left for Minnesota (CSU assistant since 2018). '26: 21-13, NIT
